description: A Java class 'AudioTrackBridge' that wraps Android's AudioTrack for audio playback, including tunnel mode support, timestamp retrieval, and buffer management.

classes.name: AudioTrackBridge
classes.description: A wrapper class for Android's AudioTrack, providing additional control and features for audio playback.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume gain for the audio track.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the audio track.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the audio track.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback of the audio track.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the audio buffer and resets internal states.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the track, supporting both byte arrays and float arrays, with optional presentation timestamp.

methods.name: getAudioTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio timestamp and frame position.

methods.name: getUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the number of buffer underruns.

methods.name: getStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames, API level 31+.
